company_name: ADTEC PLASMA TECHNOLOGY KOREA CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — ADTEC Plasma Technology Korea specializes in high-frequency RF power supplies and related equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ADTEC Plasma Technology Korea designs, manufactures, and sells high-frequency RF power supplies and automatic impedance matching devices used in semiconductor and LCD manufacturing. The company focuses on enhancing its product lineup and expanding its market presence globally.

regional_presence.Korea: ADTEC Plasma Technology Korea focuses on developing and manufacturing RF generators and matching units for the local semiconductor industry.
